scientific_integrity: Exact statements use normalized integrated Wigner-negative volume; the single-added formula and the general Laguerre Wigner profile are credited to antecedents. A direct analytic monotonicity proof establishes the new ordering phase diagram. Finite checks are corroboration, not proofs or independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Ideal normalized one- and two-photon additions to a single unsqueezed thermal mode, followed by a phase-insensitive thermal attenuator. Fixed common input seed and channel; no energy matching, heralding yield, detector noise, arbitrary Gaussian channels, or higher-order addition classification. Publication-priority risk remains from literature not fully accessible, especially Xu and Yuan (2019).
title: A universal one-to-two photon-addition crossover in thermally attenuated Wigner negativity
